positive_feedback: Reuse map honored precisely: seeded_inputs/derive_workgroups (already pub), check_correctness/correctness_match (promoted private -> pub(crate), no logic change), ulp_tolerance_for_device (already pub(crate)) are all called from optimize.rs, not re-implemented. Zero duplicated harness logic -- diff --stat confirms axc-codegen and axc-runtime are untouched.

vk==None ordering pin (SS1.3.1) implemented exactly as specified: the GpuUnavailable check sits after select_kernel and before grid_search in optimize.rs, verified both by reading the diff and by QA's independent CLI repro (AmbiguousKernel fires headless before GpuUnavailable on a 2-kernel fixture).

The two-closure design (correctness_fn detector+attributor, bench_fn resident MIN-of-N) matches SS1.5 verbatim, including the Cell/RefCell bookkeeping (ordinal, reference_ord, reference_outputs, divergence, oracle_attributed, saw_not_checked, last_timing_source) and the post-grid_search decision table in SS1.5.1/SS4 (divergence-empty -> proceed; divergence+attributed -> proceed; divergence+unattributed -> VariantsDiverge, zero artifacts).

differential_mismatch's bitwise fast-path-first ordering (reference == got check before the f32-ULP loop) is present exactly as the r3 MODERATE fix demanded, closing the NaN-collapse hole, and correctness_match/within_ulp_f32 are reused verbatim (FROZEN code untouched, grep-confirmed by QA).

AT-3015's visibility discipline is honored: cross_validate_winner_module_wide stays private; the new test lives inside optimize.rs's #[cfg(test)] mod and reaches it via in-module visibility, exactly matching the r3 MINOR fix (no promotion beyond the two named bench_variant comparators).

Migration of the three m321 call sites is faithful to the table in SS3: optimize_no_kernel_on_ambiguous_source_fails_closed -> at_3013_... (arity-only, stays headless); at_2957 -> at_3014_... (arity fix + #[ignore]/AXC_ENABLE_GPU_TESTS conversion, F3-union + F4-before-write assertions preserved, no assertion on which candidate wins); at_2970 -> split into AT-3015 (in-crate deterministic F4 unit) + at_3016_... (single-candidate ?[8] forced-winner GPU-gated leg, fixture-sanity retained, zero-artifacts assertions retained).

Part B fixes are each minimal and scoped exactly to their described bug: PW-1's collect_shared_len_hole_refs seeds referenced_holes without touching the existing undefined-len-hole scan; the i64 helper is a single new fn applied at exactly the five named parser.rs sites, with the general body-literal path (parser.rs ~1219) left untouched and AT-3010 exercising both the positive and negated i64::MIN boundaries; dominant_line_ending touches only the create-path boundary newline in log_opt.rs:297 and is proven correct by an explicit CRLF-vs-LF AT; MAX_NOTE_LEN=512 is enforced via note.len() (bytes) at the MCP boundary before any file touch, documented as bytes per the spec's resolution of the pessimistic MINOR.

Error messages are high quality and actionable: GpuUnavailable's message tells the caller exactly how to fix it (probe_vulkan_available()+VulkanContext::new(), or VK_DRIVER_FILES for Lavapipe in CI); VariantsDiverge names both the diverging ordinals and the kernel, and even suggests the remedy (register a CPU reference for kernel `{kernel}`).
main.rs wiring mirrors the existing fuzz/bench probe+construct pattern exactly as prescribed, with a comment pointing at the precedent.

QA's independent re-verification (build clean, clippy clean, 1357/0/149 workspace suite, all 13 ATs exercised on both real NVIDIA and Lavapipe, corpus-golden re-run from scratch with 34 byte-identical stems and 0 diverging) gives strong confidence the diff does what it claims beyond just reading it.

minor_issues.description: QA's defect_2 attribution correction (workgroup-hole placeholder-dispatch-geometry OOB crash is newly-triggered by this milestone's own new invariant-capture code, not merely 'pre-existing, same class' as defect 1) is well-argued and correct, but the coder's run JSON / the milestone doc do not yet carry this corrected framing. Recommend the close-out step amend the coder's defect_2 write-up (and any follow-up bug report) to attribute the triggering code to axc-driver/optimize.rs (this milestone's new closures), not axc-optimize, before a bug is filed against the wrong crate. Does not block APPROVE: the underlying fixture workaround in optimize_real_bench.rs is safe, in-scope, and intent-preserving regardless of the framing fix.

LOC 744 vs. the 700 hard cap (6.3% over) -- already flagged by QA as MINOR and honestly disclosed by the coder; confirmed via git diff --stat (1604 insertions / 138 deletions across touched files, consistent with QA's 744 net-added recount) that the overage is concentrated in test/doc comments, not schema or grid_search reimplementation. Acceptable as-is.

summary: M3.23 implementation matches the r3 spec closely and cleanly. The real-bench closure structure is a faithful glue layer over existing bench_variant/runtime primitives with no duplicated harness logic; the SS1.5.1 detector/attributor decision table is implemented exactly as specified, including the r3 fail-closed-on-unattributable-divergence semantics and the bitwise-fast-path NaN fix. All three m321 test migrations track the SS3 table precisely, and the four Part B polish fixes are each scoped to their named bug with no scope creep into FROZEN code or unrelated paths. Error messages (GpuUnavailable, VariantsDiverge) are actionable and name the right details. The only carry-forward item is a close-out documentation fix: QA's MODERATE finding that defect_2's self-report framing overstates pre-existing-ness (the triggering code is this milestone's own new invariant-capture closures, not axc-optimize) should be corrected in the coder's write-up before any follow-up bug is filed. Recommend APPROVE.
